title: Historical report media
responsibility: Converts older report references and media without presenting them as build-bound verification.

inputs.name: legacyLink.report
inputs.description: Historical report with linked commit or gap.

inputs.name: legacyEvidence.report
inputs.description: Historical report and its media entries.

outputs.name: legacyLink
outputs.description: Text identifying this commit, another linked commit, or the report’s missing-commit explanation.

outputs.name: legacyEvidence
outputs.description: Ordered gallery items labeled legacy, with no recorded build, original report attribution and missing-media markers. Unknown statuses become not-proven; MIME types beginning with audio select audio presentation.
